history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration make progress towards using the strategic management application module for programme planning purposes besides monitoring.
history.administration_response: The strategic management application module is a system of record for capturing legislatively approved plans and monitoring progress against them. This should be seen as an integral part of the holistic approach to balancing delegation and accountability, which was the cornerstone of the management reform of the Secretary-General. It was designed only for that purpose, and not for collaborative online planning that would lead to the production of print-ready legislative documents, which could be another conceivable interpretation of “programme planning purposes”. Therefore, in our best understanding “progress made in using the strategic management application module as a planning tool” means that we encourage entities to capture their plans with a greater degree of comprehensiveness than is required by the format of the programme plan or results-based budgeting. This was discussed with the auditors, and they had indicated that this was reasonable. Entities have been encouraged to do so, according to an email from the Controller.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Controller has sent out a message to senior managers’ compact focal points and strategic management application module focal points encouraging entities to use the module for comprehensive planning, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
